fusions.name: Drip Line
fusions.desc: Sheds water from your leaves onto every enemy within 3 tiles; it deals 3 water damage and leaves them [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lands on Someone Else
fusions.desc: Flicks a bead of shed water that deals 15 water damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it, and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Waxed-Leaf Sheen
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to run off your leaves and land on whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: What Drips Down
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions on an enemy runs out, it drains down to your roots: you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
